title: When Your Teen Worries They Seem Unreliable
summary: Help a teen practise one visible next commitment with an if–then cue and backup, without promising trust, forgiveness, or reputation repair.
seo_description: A parent plan for an ordinary missed commitment: help a teen choose one visible next step, add a cue and backup, and review the plan privately, not publicly.
release_move: The parent holds policy, access, wellbeing, and safety duties while the teen chooses one visible next commitment, makes an ordinary ownership statement where needed, and privately reviews the practice.

core_belief_shift.from: A missed commitment requires a parent rescue, a large apology, or a quick promise that everyone will trust my teen again.
core_belief_shift.to: My teen can practise one observable next commitment while we keep responsibility, policy, support, and social outcomes in their proper lanes.

book_relevance.reason: The War Playbook, Chapter 23 offers a teen-owned lens on deliberate signals over time; this parent guide is complete without the book and makes no reputation-repair promise.

hero.alt: A teen sets a reminder beside a calendar and sports bag while a parent listens nearby.
